# cloudendure_recovery_plan (Resource)

Manages a CloudEndure recovery plan: an ordered list of steps, each launching a group of machines.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudendure_machine" "db" {
  name = "db-01"
}

data "cloudendure_machine" "web" {
  name = "web-01"
}

resource "cloudendure_recovery_plan" "app" {
  name = "app-recovery"

  steps = [
    {
      name        = "databases"
      machine_ids = [data.cloudendure_machine.db.id]
    },
    {
      name        = "web"
      machine_ids = [data.cloudendure_machine.web.id]
      wait_before = "300"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Recovery plan name.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Ordered launch steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Recovery plan ID.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `machine_ids` (List of String) IDs of the machines launched in this step.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Step name.
- `wait_before` (String) Time to wait before launching this step, passed to the API as-is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Recovery plans are imported by recovery plan ID.
terraform import cloudendure_recovery_plan.app 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
